title: tooling(objectui-readiness 5): the workspace's own files come from workspace-root.mjs, so tests and the CLI generator read the same layout under the monorepo's ui/ (objectstack#25733)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoKJXi9asZgeRJUKMTK6ywWF)_

Part of objectstack#25733 (child 2e of the epic). Part of objectstack#25677.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## Why

Standalone, the objectui tree is the pnpm workspace root. Under the objectstack monorepo it is `ui/`, and the workspace root (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `node_modules/.pnpm`) is one level up. `ui/node_modules` then holds only the ui root package's own links. There is no `ui/node_modules/.pnpm` and no `ui/pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

Measured on a scratch worktree of the objectstack verification head `cfa1676afc`, with this tree applied under `ui/`: 12 tests went red across 5 files, before this change.

- `check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts`, 2 reds. The UNDECLARED and ROOT-DECLARED controls looked for `TREE/node_modules/.pnpm`, so both read "NOT INSTALLED", and `check:doc-snippets` exited 2.
- `vite-objectstack-client-dist.test.ts`, 5 reds. The installed client is a workspace link to `packages/client`, not a store symlink, and that link carries its own `node_modules`.
- `vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts`, 2 reds, and `vite-objectstack-workspace.test.ts`, 2 reds. The checkout's own console has the framework's `packages/` three levels up, so its tests are the merged arm and not the baseline literals.
- `packages/cli` `app-generator.test.ts`, 1 red. The in-workspace case used the checkout root as "a workspace root", and under `ui/` it is a member.

## What changes

- **`scripts/workspace-root.mjs`** gains `virtualStorePath(root = uiRoot())`, which is the workspace root's `node_modules/.pnpm`. It throws, like `workspaceRoot()`, when no workspace governs the tree. `findInstalledCopy` in `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` reads it, and returns null with no workspace. The relative path it reports reads `../node_modules/.pnpm/…` under `ui/`.
- **`@object-ui/cli` `currentContext()`** returns `isMonorepo: isWorkspaceRoot(cwd)`. That is the predicate `dev`, `serve` and `build` already use (`utils/workspace-vite.ts`, objectui#3890), and it is the same expression the function used to spell inline, `existsSync(join(cwd, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))`. See the proposal below.
- **Console vendor-chunk tests.** The standalone arm is read off a tmp fixture (`TMP/objectui/apps/console`, nothing beside it), and the merged arm off the existing monorepo-shaped fixture. The checkout itself is asked only which arm its own layout names, with `isNestedWorkspace()` as the independent witness. `vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts` compares the config's vendor test with the arm the layout selects, and pins the baseline literal separately. **The regexes in `scripts/vite-objectstack-workspace.ts` are unchanged.**
- **Client-dist test.** The dependency walk through a pnpm symlink is held on a fixture store (`node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+client@1.0.0/node_modules/{client,core}` and a console symlink). The out-of-tree copy leaves the package's own `node_modules` behind.
- **`check:ui-root-lookups`** gains the `workspace-file-at-ui-root` shape. It fires on a `join`/`resolve` (or a template led by a substitution) that names `pnpm-workspace.yaml` or `node_modules/.pnpm` and whose base resolves to the objectui tree. The base can be `uiRoot()`, `UI_ROOT`, `__dirname` / `import.meta.dirname` / `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` climbed to the tree, or a `const` or parameter default bound to one of those. It fires once, where the path first names the file. It adds 14 self-test cases, 51 in total. The allowlist entry for `app-generator.ts` is removed, because it would read stale.

## Proposal: what "runs at a workspace root" means for `currentContext()`

`currentContext()` is product code, so its meaning is written in its doc comment and proposed here. "Runs at a workspace root" means **cwd itself holds `pnpm-workspace.yaml`**, the same predicate `dev`, `serve` and `build` use to skip install and to alias. A workspace **member** gets the standalone map. That covers a user's package inside their own monorepo, and objectui under `ui/`. The generator does not walk up, because walking up would hand a member the empty in-workspace maps, and no alias table backs those maps at a member's cwd.

**A user's project behaves exactly as before.** With the file in cwd it gets the in-workspace map, and without it the standalone map, because the expression is the same. Two tests pin it, both from fixtures: the in-workspace case runs from a fixture workspace root, and a new case runs from a fixture member and expects the standalone map.

## Reverse check

The new gate shape, run on the pristine #13491 head (`f8fa141`), fires at exactly the two sites this PR changes, and nowhere else outside the allowlist:

- `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` `findInstalledCopy`, `workspace-file-at-ui-root`, `join(root, 'node_modules', '.pnpm')`
- `packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts` `currentContext`, `marker-probe`, `existsSync(join(cwd, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))`

## Verification

**objectui standalone**, on this branch (main `6c3340c` plus this commit, after `pnpm run setup`). Every command exited 0:

`pnpm check:ui-root-lookups` · `node scripts/check-ui-root-lookups.mjs --self-test` (51 cases) · `pnpm check:new-line-citations` · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` · `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` · `pnpm check:changeset-claims` · `pnpm type-check:scripts` · `pnpm check:test-path-roots` · `pnpm check:pre-install-import-graph` · `pnpm check:control-bytes` · `pnpm exec eslint` over the changed files (0 errors) · `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli test` (30 files, 416 tests).

`pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__` was run whole in three shards (`--shard=K/3`, under the verify lock): 196 files passed, 5787 tests. Two files were skipped by their own `IS_CHILD` conditions.

**Merged layout.** I used a scratch worktree of the objectstack verification head `cfa1676afc`. I installed it and ran the CI build of the seven `@objectstack` packages, plus the `@object-ui` closure `check:doc-snippets` builds. Then I applied #13491's diff and this diff under `ui/` with `git apply --directory=ui`. This diff applies to the landed main unchanged; it is byte-identical apart from blob ids.

- The 7 touched script test files: 293/293 passed.
- `vitest run --root . packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts`: 48/48 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:ui-root-lookups`: OK, 6 allowlist entries live.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:doc-snippets`: exit 0, 811 blocks compiled. Both controls are live and installed at `../node_modules/.pnpm/…`.
- Control, before this diff: the same 7 files plus the CLI test showed the 12 reds above, and `check:doc-snippets` exited 2 with both controls "NOT INSTALLED".

## Bound of the new gate shape

Two of the three classes this card fixes are not syntactic joins: the CLI test treating the checkout root as a workspace root, and the vite sibling-directory probe. They are out of the gate's reach, and so are a path assembled through `let` or across files. The gate header states this bound.

## Out of scope

Pin scripts (objectstack#25711), spec drift (objectstack#25727), QUICK_REFERENCE (objectstack#25697), dependency versions (objectstack#25726), `.github/**`.
